exposure: Previous caesarean delivery vs. previous vaginal delivery
cohort: 654 pregnant women at 28 weeks gestation who attended Imam Reza Hospital in Kermanshah, Iran, between 2014 and 2015
finding: Previous caesarean delivery was significantly associated with a higher risk of preterm labor but a lower risk of preeclampsia in the subsequent pregnancy.
mod_finding: The study found that previous caesarean delivery was significantly associated with a higher risk of preterm labor.
gest_age: 28 weeks at study entry, mean gestational age at delivery: 38.26 weeks (case group) and 38.06 weeks (control group)
